text: The union voted. Fix my hive in four minutes, or we're moving to the Moon.
Honeymoon One is fueled. With honey. Clock's running.
Beeswax. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. No stinger, no job, so they made me union rep.
Four things are killing my hive. Fix them and the door opens.
See that window? That's the meadow's future. Every choice you make shows up in there. Live.
In one recent year, American beekeepers lost more than half their managed colonies. Hence the rocket.
The girls are furious. Calm them down. Pick one.
You SWATTED them? A squished bee gives off more alarm smell. Now they're angrier. Grievance filed. Try again.
Water? Now they're wet AND angry. Grievance filed. Try again.
Ahh. Smoke covers up our alarm signal and makes us fill up on honey. Also, our alarm smells like bananas. Don't eat one near my house.
Is there enough food in there? Tip the hive. Go on, lift it.
We're starving.
So feed us. Store-bought honey, or sugar syrup?
...Grievance filed. Store honey can carry foulbrood, a disease that wipes out hives. The spores last for decades.
Sugar syrup. Motion carried. Beekeepers lift the hive to check for food, then feed syrup. Never store honey.
Wasps at the door. Again. Make the entrance bigger, or smaller?
Bigger?! That's more door to guard. They're walking right in. Grievance filed.
Smaller door, fewer guards needed to hold it. Look at them give up. Motion carried.
HORNET! A giant one! Everybody ball up! Make a FIST!
Now HUM!
Japanese honeybees ball up and cook hornets. About forty-six degrees. Louder!
STOP, you're cooking the girls!
Heat wave. The hive's baking. We need water. Pick a dish.
A deep bowl? We can't swim. Bees drown in deep water. Grievance filed.
Nothing? We're melting in here. Noted for the minutes. Angrily.
Pebbles! Somewhere to land. We spread water drops in the hive and fan our wings. Bee air conditioning.
Your turn. Ask the window something. Start with "what if."
Don't. Say. That. ...You said it. Look at the window.
Okay. Okay. It's out. Motion to never say that again: carried.
Rain? Fine. Nobody forages in the rain. We stay in and do paperwork.
Clover? Now you're talking. More flowers, more food. I'll allow it.
Pesticide spray? It drifts onto the flowers and we carry it home. Grievance filed.
Winter? We huddle around the queen and shiver to keep her warm. All winter.
Fine. Back to how it was. Noted for the minutes.
Undo what? Nothing's on fire. Yet.
Motion carried. The union votes to stay.
...I'm still going. Ticket's non-refundable.
TAKE ME TO THE MOON!
...Not one flower. Only planet with flowers.
I'm back. Nobody saw that.
Same time tomorrow? There are six more hives.
Noted for the minutes.
I'll allow it.
Grievance filed.
Motion carried.
Motion denied.
Tabled until the next meeting.
Adding that to the spreadsheet.
Point of order. Hive first, questions later.
What IS that? Not on the agenda.
That's a person. I review hives, not people.
Testing. You smell like coffee.
Not now, I'm monologuing.
I can't reach the hive. Check the hotspot.
Lost the signal. Press again.
Hold still. I'm reviewing it.
Still reviewing. Union rules. No rushing.
What IS that? Not on the agenda.
Psst. The smoker. Squeeze it.
Psst. Lift the hive first. Then syrup.
Psst. Smaller door. Fewer guards.
Psst. Shallow water. With pebbles.
Ask it: what if a fire starts?
That window is live. Talk to it.
Not all wasps are bad. Just that guy.
